name: @voltlabs/cnat
description: Transformer-based phase identification at arbitrary points (CNAT; Watanabe, Sato & Shibuta, Comput. Mater. Sci. 2027): labels atoms liquid, FCC, HCP or BCC from their 79 nearest neighbours (or olivine on a forsterite oxygen sublattice), evaluates the phase field on a grid and exports the solid-liquid interface mesh.
